findings.evidence: Original numeric event clocks dated2026-01-01 compute0days at fixed2026-10-09UTC instead of281days. The legacy diagnostic used naive utcfromtimestamp, swallowed aware subtraction failure and fabricated0. Missing/bool/nonfinite/negative/future clocks also lacked honest unknown handling.
findings.repair: Legacy diagnostic retains aware UTC elapsed event-time arithmetic and returns None for missing/invalid/future data. It is no longer called by profile candidate admission and does not prove mint age.

findings.evidence: Original fallback omitted required pairId on pair lookup; first truthy response ended source collection even when foreign-chain/unknown envelope. Synthetic original native flow suppresses independent secondary identities.
findings.repair: Use two actual documented profile feeds, independently accepting known collection/single-profile shapes and preserving empty versus unavailable. Serial existing source owner combines feed row order round-robin; common guarded entry remains sole buying owner.

findings.evidence: Original row path can raise on non-dict rows, accepts missing chain and pair/base/address aliases in cross-chain profile input, and truncates the first source rather than distinct combined identities.
findings.repair: Only explicit canonical Solana profile identities become candidate mints; isolate invalid rows, retain original per-feed order, case-sensitive dedup and cap only unique valid identities. Unknown feed envelopes never become healthy empty success.

contracts.payload: Lists, single canonical profile-shaped object and retained token collection envelopes; unrecognized envelope is unavailable. No pair/base/address identity fallback in profile input.
contracts.clock: No profile/listing/pair/age metadata is passed to entry or used to infer eligibility. Legacy elapsed event clock diagnostic is nullable and UTC, not birth proof.
contracts.coverage: Both feeds queried once serially in the existing supervised discovery owner; fair interleaving does not rank by advertising or fabricate learned opportunity scores. No retry/catch-up or new operational daemon.
contracts.empty_or_fault: At least one known collection, even empty, can establish a completed discovery tick. Both unavailable/unknown responses raise to actual poll owner, retaining prior success clock and recording error.
contracts.timeouts: Existing configured positive finite timeout,20s fallback for invalid values; cancellation is propagated and owned HTTP cleanup finishes before feed owner drain.
contracts.cap: 0 retains existing unlimited candidate behavior; negative/malformed/bool cap does not accidentally become a one-item limit. Configured positive cap counts distinct validated canonical identities.
contracts.risk: Discovery is not permission to buy. Existing source preparation, nullable age wait, sizing/exposure, capital, router execution and exit guards are unchanged.
